details.description:
Puttu is the favourite breakfast of kids and youngsters in Kerala. Puttu is also famous in Tamil Nadu. Basically, puttu is steamed cylinders of ground rice layered with grated coconut. details.description:

Many people like the recipe’s simplicity and amazing flavours.

Even a soaked sweet version of aval with jaggery can be eaten as a snack in the evenings.
details.ingredients: Matta Rice
details.usageInstructions:
Roast the rice flakes (Aval) for 10 minutes on low flame without oil, till it becomes crispy ( or you can oven heat it on 100% power for 3 minutes).
Melt jaggery in necessary water.
Add cardamom powder, cashew nuts, grated coconuts and raisins.
Stir well for a few minutes. add Aval into it and mix well.
Your Aval roast is ready.

details.description: A fine blend of spices like Chilli, Coriander, Tamarind, Cumin and Garlic, among many more, Fish Curry Masala has a great taste, colour and add texture to your fish curry. details.usageInstructions:
Recipes: 
1] Cleaned Fish(cut into pieces)-1 kg, 
2] Ginger-1pieces, 
3] Tomato-1, 
4] Salt-to taste, 
5] Coccum-2 pieces, 
6| Curry Leafs-3 stem, 
7] Nirapara_ Fish Masala-4 tbsp, 
8] Shallots-5, 
9] Coconut Oil-1 tbsp. 
Method: Add Nirapara Fish Masala and coconut oil with the Fish pieces and mix well. Saute ginger (cut in long pieces), shallots and curry leaves in heated coconut oil. Add fish pieces and saute again when the masala is thoroughly mixed with the fish pieces. Add a cup of water and then, add tomato pieces, coccum and salt to taste and boil in low heat. When the fish is well cooked, add 1/2 cup of coconut milk and serve.

details.description: Nirapara tender-mango pickle is a delicacy unique to Kerala. This amazing pickle is true to its name and is made from tender, young, unripe mango. Like most pickles, tender-mango pickles are prepared using traditional spices and edible oil. Unlike most other pickles, it is aged ideally in the traditional pickle urns for at least a week. Nirapara tender-mango pickles ensure that the tender mangoes remain unwrinkled and soaked thoroughly in the spice and salt mixture that is used to preserve them.
